_comment: Ordered path rules (first match wins) that assign every operation in the three pinned GoDaddy Domains specs (v1, v2, v3) to a StackQL service. Consumed by bin/split.mjs and map_operations.mjs; a path with no rule fails the split without writing. v3 paths are matched after their /v3/domains rebase.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Registered domain inventory, settings and lifecycle: domain details, contacts, nameservers, renewal, cancellation, registrant changes, privacy forwarding, pending actions and notifications (Domains v1 and v2), the v3 domain list and asynchronous operations, and monthly API usage.

dns.title: DNS
dns.description: DNS zone records (Domains v1 bulk record management and the Domains v3 record-id based CRUD) and domain forwarding rules (Domains v2).

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Finding and registering domains: availability checks, suggestions, TLDs, legal agreements, purchase schemas and validation (Domains v1), asynchronous registration (Domains v2), and the quote-then-register model with registration status (Domains v3).

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.description: Inbound and outbound domain transfers: the Domains v1 transfer-in order and the Domains v2 asynchronous transfer workflow (accept, cancel, restart, retry, transfer out, accept or reject an outbound transfer).
